name: geomarmot-rust-web
description: Spike: the Rust compiler in the browser over DuckDB-Wasm.

scripts.build:wasm: cd .. && cargo build --release --target wasm32-unknown-unknown -p geomarmot-web && wasm-bindgen --target web --out-dir web/pkg target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release/geomarmot_web.wasm && cargo build --release --target wasm32-unknown-unknown -p geomarmot-app --lib && wasm-bindgen --target web --out-dir web/app-pkg target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release/geomarmot_app.wasm
